title: Central and Inscribed Angles Practice
description: Practice relating central angles, inscribed angles, and intercepted arcs.

questions.question: A central angle measures 84 degrees. What is the measure of its intercepted arc?
questions.explanation: A central angle has the same measure as its intercepted arc.

questions.question: An inscribed angle intercepts an arc measuring 120 degrees. What is the measure of the inscribed angle?
questions.explanation: An inscribed angle is half its intercepted arc, so 120 divided by 2 is 60.

questions.question: A central angle is always half the measure of its intercepted arc.
questions.explanation: A central angle equals its intercepted arc. An inscribed angle is half its intercepted arc.

questions.question: An inscribed angle measures 37 degrees. Enter the measure of its intercepted arc in degrees.
questions.explanation: The intercepted arc is twice the inscribed angle: 2 x 37 = 74.

questions.question: A central angle and an inscribed angle intercept the same arc. If the central angle measures 98 degrees, what is the inscribed angle?
questions.explanation: The inscribed angle is half the arc. Since the central angle equals the arc, the inscribed angle is half of 98, or 49 degrees.

questions.question: Which description matches an inscribed angle?
options: Its vertex is at the center of the circle.
Its vertex is on the circle and its sides are chords.
Its vertex is outside the circle.
questions.explanation: An inscribed angle has its vertex on the circle, and its sides are chords of the circle.

questions.question: An arc measures 156 degrees. Enter the measure of an inscribed angle that intercepts this arc.
questions.explanation: An inscribed angle is half the intercepted arc: 156 divided by 2 is 78.

questions.question: Explain the difference between the central angle rule and the inscribed angle rule.
questions.correctAnswer: A central angle has the same measure as its intercepted arc, while an inscribed angle has half the measure of its intercepted arc.
questions.explanation: The key difference is the vertex location: center means equal to the arc, and on the circle means half the arc.
